name: steward-skills-install
title: workstation-steward: installing the Claude Code skills
desc: An illustrative session, looping, in two scenes. steward skills install shows what it will install (the four skills, from the installed steward's own marketplace file; nothing is fetched), what it changes and how to undo it, asks, and installs the steward plugin for every Claude Code session. Then, in Claude Code, typing /steward: lists the four skills.

scenes.out: steward skills install: the steward's Claude Code skills, in every Claude Code session you start, in any
skills:   supply-chain, ai-tooling, projects, pr-consolidation (from your add-ons)
accepts:  the plugin's command `steward skills path`, which Claude Code runs each session (from this
release's own marketplace file, copied to ~/.local/state/…/skills/marketplace; nothing is fetched)
runs:     claude plugin install steward --marketplace ~/.local/state/…/skills/marketplace --scope user --yes

segs: Successfully added marketplace: workstation-steward (declared in user settings)

scenes.out: Installed: steward@workstation-steward. A new Claude Code session loads /steward:supply-chain and the rest.

segs: Keeps this machine's software supply chain current within policy…
Keeps this machine's AI tooling consistent with policy…
Discovers projects under the project roots set in steward.toml…
Consolidates open Dependabot and/or Renovate dependency PRs…

scenes.out: # or skip the slash: ask in plain words, and Claude picks the skill
